body: A generator picks a snippet for each slide. I specified "the first block that fits". It did that, perfectly.
On a post about the five second startForeground() window it chose a WorkManager snippet. Right file, real API, wrong point.

head: Wrong code
gets caught.
*Plausible code ships.
body: Borrowed work does not fail like bad work. It fails like confident work that answers a question slightly next to the one you asked.
The trouble is what happens where you stopped describing.
